_comment: This repository's own file-name configuration. Every key is documented in plugins/docs-hygiene/reference/config.md. docs/ is the scope root; ADR, spec, upstream, and unhobble trees are the historical tier, so their links and paths are repointed and their narrative is left as written; released changelog entries are frozen; and docs/architecture/landscape.json is generated rather than edited. The two sweep exclusions under plugins/ are vocabulary collisions, not scope calls: the teach and curate-language skills document a learner-workspace GLOSSARY.md that has nothing to do with docs/glossary.md, and a basename sweep cannot tell them apart. They are scoped to those two skills so the rest of both plugins is still swept.

generated.regenerate: bash plugins/architecture/skills/map-landscape/scripts/landscape-record.sh --source 'current repository plus reference graph' --remote 'not used' --edges-from . . > docs/architecture/landscape.json
